تختلسون (form VIII)
# تَخْتَلِسُونَ (taḵtalisūna) /tax.ta.li.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
# تُخْتَلَسُونَ (tuḵtalasūna) /tux.ta.la.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
